description:
**Conversation Summary**

1. Request: redesign the tool-details UI "opened under the chat entry menu" into a denser, wall-like list that exposes tool name, params and status without expanding — expanded view must stay unchanged.
2. First attempt targeted `ChatEntryTools.vue` (compact timeline path); user clarified the real target was the per-message tools panel, `src/components/chat/ChatMessageEvents.vue`.
3. `ChatMessageEvents.vue` was reworked into a continuous feed: `divide-y` rows with a left status accent, index, mono tool name, duration, timestamp (`@lg/panel`+), arg count, an always-visible `key → value` params grid (3 rows + "+N more"), and an inline line-clamped error line; `Arguments`/`Result`/`Error`/`Output` detail blocks untouched.
4. Styling/engineering notes: status never conveyed by color alone (accent + distinct icons + `title` text), truncated values keep full content in `title`, per-row data precomputed in a `tools` computed, `aria-expanded` on row toggles, `tabular-nums` for streaming alignment.
5. Final turn: panel made `sticky` under the chat entry header (`top-[27px]`, `@lg/panel:top-[33px]`, `z-10`, opaque `bg-base-100`, `max-h-[60vh]` internal scroll) and the redundant `done`/`error` badges were removed from tool rows (status moved into the row `title`); lifecycle rows keep their badge since their icon does not encode status.

messages.content: Change the design for a more wall like with bit more info about the tool in the summary and not only the tool name. It should be easy to follow the tools and params without having to open them. Detailed opened view is fine, no changes.
